rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site aggregated dataset; 87 datasets from 20 countries (Europe, Australia, USA, South Africa, and east Asia).
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We collated de-identified data from 87 datasets from Europe, Australia, the USA, South Africa, and east Asia"

rci2_using_epd.detail: Contributing datasets include multiple EPDs: ABCD, ABIDE, Cam-CAN, HCP (Aging, Adult, Development), UK Biobank, ADNI (ADNIGO), Healthy Brain Network (HBN/CMI), and NKI-Rockland Sample.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "ABCD, The Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study; ABIDE, Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange; ADNIGO, Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative; Cam-CAN, Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience; HCP Aging, Adult Brain, Development, Human Connectome Project; Healthy Brain Network/CMI, Healthy Brain Network/Child Mind Institute; Rockland, Nathan Kline Institute-Rockland Sample; ... UK BIOBANK"

rci3_epd_name.answer: ABCD; ABIDE; Cam-CAN; HCP; UK Biobank; ADNI; HBN; NKI
rci3_epd_name.detail: Eight EPDs identified in the contributing dataset list: ABCD, ABIDE, Cam-CAN, HCP (multiple sub-studies: Aging, Adult, Development), UK Biobank, ADNI (ADNIGO), Healthy Brain Network (HBN/CMI), and Nathan Kline Institute-Rockland Sample (NKI).
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "ABCD, The Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development Study; ABIDE, Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange; ADNIGO, Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative; Cam-CAN, Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience; HCP Aging, Adult Brain, Development, Human Connectome Project; Healthy Brain Network/CMI, Healthy Brain Network/Child Mind Institute; Rockland, Nathan Kline Institute-Rockland Sample; ... UK BIOBANK"

rci5_n.detail: Overall reference cohort N (training 80% + testing 20% combined). Training-phase N not separately reported.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "A total of 37 407 healthy individuals from 87 datasets from 20 countries were included in this study."

rci6_sex.detail: Overall reference cohort; percentages calculated from reported counts (19964 / 37407 = 53.4%; 17443 / 37407 = 46.6%).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "This sample consisted of 19 964 females and 17 443 males."

rci7_age.detail: Overall reference cohort age range in years. Mean and SD not reported.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "37 407 healthy individuals (53% female and 47% male; aged 3-90 years)"
